CustomField.label: Broker
CustomField.description: The submitting broker who brought this deal - the Contact created when their Lead was converted, and the same person carrying the Broker Protection claim. Stamped automatically by LeadConvertService at conversion, mirroring the primary Broker OpportunityContactRole so the broker is visible on the page, in list views and in reports. NOT the listing broker from the offering memorandum - that is Listing_Broker_Name__c / Listing_Broker_Email__c and is often a different person.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The broker who submitted this deal to DPEG. Set automatically on lead conversion. If the offering memorandum names a different listing broker, that person is in the Listing Broker Name and Listing Broker Email fields instead.
